dedupe_keys.name: croplayer 2 m cropland map of china for 2020

description: A very high resolution cropland map of China. The Zenodo record says CropLayer maps cropland across China for 2020 at 2 m from Mapbox and Google imagery, using an image quality model, active learning with a Mask2Former segmentation model and XGBoost checks, and a fusion of the two image sources. It reports 88.73 per cent pixel accuracy, 96.5 per cent block-level correctness, and area estimates within 10 per cent of official statistics in 30 of 32 provinces, against 1 to 9 provinces for eight earlier products. Data are split into 32 county-level archives by province, free to download under CC BY 4.0, published 23 January 2025, and linked to a paper in Earth System Science Data. Coverage is China. Caveats: a single year, and several province archives exceed 1.5 GB. For simulation it gives field-level cropland extent to count farmland exposed to floods, drought or landslides. A related catalogue record is the Northeast China cropland parcels dataset.
